# Country scope. The country whose weekly and monthly pulse drives the Council clock (the first to pulse; the next one if it vanishes).
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_clock = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { global.cwcm_clock = THIS.id }
		check_variable = { global.cwcm_clock = 0 }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_clock > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_clock = { exists = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Full member of the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance.
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = {
	check_variable = { cwcm_status = 5 }
}

# Country scope. Admitted by the Session; member on the next 1 July.
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_acceding = {
	check_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 }
}

# Country scope. Has applied (or is admitted and waiting for 1 July).
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_applicant = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { cwcm_status = 2 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Co-operation partner (agreement with the Council).
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_associate = {
	check_variable = { cwcm_status = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Observer at the Council.
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_observer = {
	check_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 }
}

# Country scope. Member that takes no part (Albania since 1961).
COLDWAR_CMEA_is_inactive = {
	check_variable = { cwcm_status = 7 }
}

# Country scope. A member governed by a player right now (a seated delegation).
COLDWAR_CMEA_player_member = {
	is_ai = no
	check_variable = { cwcm_status = 5 }
}

# Country scope. Governed by a player now or in the last 365 days (absent player).
COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = {
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen
	}
}

# Country scope. A government of the socialist camp (condition for membership).
COLDWAR_CMEA_socialist_clause = {
	OR = {
		has_communist_government = yes
		has_idea = communist_dictatorship
	}
}

# Country scope. Conditions for an application (players only; the AI never applies). Albania, an inactive member, applies to resume its participation.
COLDWAR_CMEA_can_apply = {
	has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized
	NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved }
	exists = yes
	is_subject = no
	COLDWAR_CMEA_socialist_clause = yes
	NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_applicant = yes }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_rejoin_cooldown }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes }
	NOT = { any_of_scopes = { array = global.cwcm_members has_war_with = PREV } }
}

# Any scope. At least one member is governed by a player.
COLDWAR_CMEA_any_player_member = {
	any_of_scopes = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		is_ai = no
	}
}

# Country scope. Holds the Secretariat (the elected Secretary, or the Chair ad interim while the office is vacant).

# Country scope. Can receive a Council programme abroad: a player country outside the Council without a running programme.
COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_target_ok = {
	exists = yes
	is_ai = no
	NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
	NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target = THIS.id } }
}

# Viewer scope. Enough political power for the selected proposal (the Secretary pays half).
COLDWAR_CMEA_selected_affordable = {
	OR = {

# Viewer scope. The selected proposal has a valid target.
COLDWAR_CMEA_selected_target_ok = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 1 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 2 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 3 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 4 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 5 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 6 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 7 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 8 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 21 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 22 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 23 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 24 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 25 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 26 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 41 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 42 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 43 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 44 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 45 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 46 }
		check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 47 }
		AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 61 } check_variable = { cwcm_ui_target > 0 } var:cwcm_ui_target = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwcm_status = 2 } NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_target_busy = yes } } }
		AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 62 } check_variable = { cwcm_ui_target > 0 } var:cwcm_ui_target = { exists = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_target_busy = yes } } }
		AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 63 } check_variable = { cwcm_ui_target > 0 } var:cwcm_ui_target = { exists = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_target_busy = yes } } }
		AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 64 } country_exists = SER SER = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_target_busy = yes } } }
		AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 65 } check_variable = { global.cwec_pres > 0 } var:global.cwec_pres = { exists = yes } }
		AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_sel = 66 } country_exists = CHI }
	}
}

# Country scope. Already the subject of an open file.
COLDWAR_CMEA_target_busy = {
	OR = { AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target = THIS.id } } }
}
